contributions.detail: A NIL ANNUAL OFFICEHOLDER REPORT. Every one of the cover's nine money cells is typed with the words 'None/Zero'; under the zero-glyph ruling the written word zero denotes 0, so all three columns are 0 and the period and cumulative scopes coincide. Form A's single filled line is a DECLARATION, not a transaction: Date 'Jan 1, 2025 - Dec' (a period range, truncated by the cell), Name of Donor 'None', Amount 'None', In Kind 'No' - no date, no donor and no figure, so zero rows are emitted. Form A's printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS cell holds only the Excel accounting dash, recorded verbatim as '-' (a bare dash stays blank; it is not a numeral), which is why the cover line rather than the schedule footer is the anchor. This cover generation has no $50-or-less line, so cover_le50_* are null (field absent), not zero.

expenditures.detail: Form B's single filled line is likewise a declaration - Date '7-Jan-26', Person or Organization Paid 'None', Purpose 'None', Amount 'Zero/None' - so zero rows. Printed TOTAL EXPENDITURES cell holds only the accounting dash, recorded verbatim.

gates.page_subtotal: Neither schedule prints a numeric total - both TOTAL cells carry only the Excel accounting dash - so the cover's 'None/Zero' lines are the only anchors, and zero rows agree with them. Gate stated rather than fired.

notes: THE DOCUMENT CONTRADICTS THE CHUNK FILE ON OFFICE: the chunk file (from index.csv) says 'Recorder'; the form's own 'Candidate for Office Of' line reads 'Recorder/Surveyor' on the cover and on Form B, and 'Recorder/Survey' (truncated) on Form A.
